LanguageData.RP_ToggleDanger: Show the danger map - violence the staff saw in the last 30 days, fading with age, as a red glow on the ground and a letter on the spot. F a fight, S a stabbing (a fight with a weapon a guard or camera saw), A an assault on staff, R a riot starting, D a killing or a death from wounds (illness, age and hunger are not on it). A fight, an assault or a riot is loud enough to be marked wherever it happens; a weapon only where it was seen (the coverage map shows the blind spots). The Deployment tab names the three hottest patches.
LanguageData.RP_DeployDangerNone: No violence the staff saw in the last 30 days.
LanguageData.RP_DeployDangerTip: Where the staff saw violence in the last 30 days (older counts for less), by patch of a painted zone. Post guards and cameras there. The danger map on the map's toggles shows each mark.
